operations.title: A generic finite marked sextic carries a canonical anti-invariant Kato-Gysin line
operations.description: For the ordered representative (g1,g2), the Cayley-Menger double cover has local form w^2=S+alpha*x+beta*y+O((x,y)^2) on the generic smooth sextic locus. Ordered double residue sends da∧db/(q_g1 q_g2 w) to -1/w, the primitive anti-invariant Kummer trace-kernel line.
